scripts.build: npm run build -w @ecg-edu/shared && npm run build -w @ecg-edu/api && npm run build -w @ecg-edu/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @ecg-edu/shared && npm run lint -w @ecg-edu/api && npm run lint -w @ecg-edu/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ecg-edu/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ecg-edu/api && npm run typecheck -w @ecg-edu/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @ecg-edu/shared && npm run build -w @ecg-edu/api && node scripts/db-seed.cjs
scripts.test:postgres: npm run build -w @ecg-edu/shared && npm run build -w @ecg-edu/api && node --test apps/api/test/postgres/*.test.cjs
scripts.build:demo: npm run build -w @ecg-edu/shared && NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/ecg-edu npm run build -w @ecg-edu/web
